title: Sr. US IT Recruiter
description:
Job Title: US IT Recruiter

Experience: 6 Months – 1 Year

Location : India / Remote (Coimbatore Candidates Only)

Job Summary:

We are looking for a motivated US IT Recruiter with 6 months to 1 year of experience in US staffing. The candidate will be responsible for sourcing, screening, and coordinating IT candidates for US-based client requirements.

Responsibilities:

Source candidates through Dice, LinkedIn, Indeed, Monster, CareerBuilder, and other job portals. Review resumes and match candidates with technical job requirements. Conduct initial candidate screening and qualification calls. Understand basic US visa categories, work authorization, and employment types. Maintain and update candidate information in ATS/CRM systems. Coordinate interviews between candidates and clients. Follow up with candidates regarding interview status and feedback. Build and maintain a strong candidate pipeline. Negotiate compensation and confirm candidate availability. Meet daily/weekly sourcing and submission targets. Maintain regular communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Required Skills:

6 months–1 year of experience in US IT Recruitment/Staffing. Basic understanding of US IT recruiting and staffing processes. Good knowledge of technical skills and IT job requirements. Experience with Boolean search and resume sourcing. Familiarity with Dice, LinkedIn, Indeed, or similar job portals. Good verbal and written communication skills. Strong follow-up and candidate engagement skills. Ability to work in a target-driven environment. Willingness to work in US time zones/night shifts. Key Skills:

US IT Recruitment | IT Staffing | Candidate Sourcing | Boolean Search | Dice | LinkedIn | Resume Screening | Candidate Screening | US Visa Basics | Interview Coordination | Candidate Follow-up | ATS/CRM

Pay: ₹10,000.00 - ₹12,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: HR Field recruiter - Coimbatore (kaniyur)
description:
Key Responsibilities

* Manage end-to-end recruitment for frontline and operational positions such as Delivery Executives, Ground Staff, Warehouse Executives, Pick-up Executives, Loaders and other hub-level requirements.
* Source candidates through field visits, walk-ins, local references, job portals, social media, recruitment agencies and other channels.
* Conduct regular field recruitment activities in and around assigned hubs/locations.
* Organize and manage walk-in drives and local hiring campaigns.
* Screen candidates based on eligibility, location, experience and operational requirements.
* Coordinate interviews and selection with the respective Operations/HR teams.
* Ensure selected candidates complete documentation and onboarding within the required TAT.
* Maintain a healthy pipeline of candidates for current and upcoming manpower requirements.
* Track daily hiring funnel including leads generated, contacted candidates, shortlisted candidates, selected candidates and joining numbers.
* Coordinate with vendors and local recruitment partners for additional manpower requirements.
* Follow up with selected candidates until joining and minimize candidate dropouts.
* Support replacement hiring against attrition and ensure manpower availability at assigned locations.
* Maintain accurate recruitment trackers and share daily/weekly hiring updates with the HR team.
* Identify new local sourcing channels and improve hiring conversion.
* Ensure compliance with company hiring and onboarding processes

Pay: ₹18,000.00 - ₹22,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement

Work Location: In person

**Job Overview**

We are looking for a dedicated and energetic HR Recruiter with 2+ years of experience who can

independently manage end-to-end recruitment. The ideal candidate must have a ready-to-learn

mindset, a happy face, and a peaceful, positive attitude while working with candidates and internal

This role is fully recruitment-driven. Were looking for someone who thrives in hiring, understands

technical and operational roles, and leverages modern recruitment tools including AI-powered

platforms to identify and attract top talent.

**What We Expect**

We are looking for someone who:

Has 2+ years of strong recruitment experience (technical + non-technical).

Has a ready-to-learn mindset and adapts quickly to new tools and trends.

Maintains a happy face, calm communication, and a peaceful mind even under pressure.

Has hands-on experience using Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other job portals.

Has basic AI knowledge relevant to recruitment trends.

Works confidently as a team player, supporting HR and hiring managers.

Is passionate about recruitment and enjoys interacting with candidates.

Can manage multiple roles with ownership, discipline, and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities

End-to-End Recruitment

Handle full-cycle hiring for technical and non-technical roles.

Source candidates using Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals, and internal databases.

Conduct screening calls to evaluate skills, experience, and cultural fit.

Coordinate assessments, assignments, and technical tests.

Schedule interviews with hiring managers and department heads.

Support offer discussions and ensure smooth candidate closure.

**Talent Sourcing & Pipeline Development**

Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for future requirements.

Engage with passive candidates and maintain long-term relationships.

Keep talent pool sheets updated and organized.

**Candidate Experience**

Maintain a positive, respectful, and professional communication style.

Ensure timely follow-ups and smooth recruitment flow.

Represent the company culture with a happy face and peaceful attitude.

**Requirement Coordination**

Work closely with hiring managers to understand job requirements.

Assist in drafting and updating job descriptions.

Provide insights on market availability and candidate expectations.

**AI & Modern Recruitment Tools**

Use AI-assisted tools for resume screening, candidate matching, and sourcing.

Stay updated with modern recruitment trends and technologies.

Apply basic AI knowledge to improve hiring efficiency.

**Documentation & Tracking**

Maintain recruitment trackers, candidate databases, and interview logs.

Ensure all recruitment data is organized, accurate, and up-to-date.

Use ATS or AI tools for structured candidate management.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

UG Degree: B.Sc CS / B.Sc IT / BE / B.Tech (CS or related fields)

Minimum 2+ years of recruitment experience

Strong sourcing skills using Naukri, Indeed, LinkedIn, and other portals

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills & ability to work as a team player

Positive attitude, happy face, and peaceful communication style

title: On-site Technology Senior Support Specialist
description:
Location: Coimbatore
Other locations: Primary Location Only
Salary: Competitive
Date: 17 Sept 2026
**Job description**
-------------------


Requisition ID: 1742013
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  


**On\-site Technology Senior Support Specialist**


**(Senior Associate)**

  


**Enterprise Technology (ET)**



Enterprise Technology provides reliable, secure and resilient technology services and solutions to support over 300,000 EY people. As part of Enterprise Technology, you’ll be at the forefront of enabling innovative technologies including emerging collaboration tools and world\-class technology infrastructure.



Our aim is to build an outstanding customer experience with clear investment in innovation, alongside operational excellence that delivers efficient, quality services and solutions. You will work with technologists and business specialists to meet the increasing pace of our business. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices, and the chance to make a real impact.

  


**The opportunity**



As part of Enterprise Technology, the On\-site Technology Support’s mission is to help our customers fulfil their purposes and contribute to building a better working world by providing a fit for purpose support service.



The On\-site Technology Support Senior Specialist provides this support to customers within the country or site by performing the highest level of multiple technology support activities. This professional provides meaningful contributions to team efforts to enhance effectiveness; acts creatively to prioritize tasks; interprets information; and applies technical knowledge to satisfy customer and firm objectives. This professional anticipates technology support issues and creates solutions with appropriate consultation.

  


**Your key responsibilities**


* Facilitate and support the deployment of hardware and software to end users (including the installation, configuration and testing of more complex firm hardware).
* Assist with (or coordinate) the repair of end user hardware and the reinstallation of software as necessary to resolve end user incidents.
* Resolve complex incidents associated with firm\-standard end user software and hardware, including mobile/hand\-held technologies. Identify sources and trends of technical problems to prevent future occurrences.
* Acts as a lead to less experienced specialists
* Provide after\-hours service for escalated issues or tasks from the Service Desk or supervisor.
* Perform asset management activities (procurement, receipt, inventory, tracking, distribution, etc.) as assigned and in accordance with firm policy and EY Technology process.
* Anticipates technology support issues and acts to creatively to prioritize tasks, interpret solutions and apply knowledge to facilitate the development and implementation of technical business solutions to complex customer technology needs and issues
* Works independently on small projects and assesses the local needs of area offices and responds appropriately
* Document and track the status of enquiries, coordinate appropriate responses and follow\-up to ensure customer satisfaction
* Work effectively as “remote hands” for other EY Technology functions, such as Telecommunications and Hosting.
* Maintain a thorough understanding of EY Technology’s organization and service offerings in order to identify how best to address end user technology needs and incidents.
* Understand the Firm’s business and organization sufficiently to anticipate and resolve end user technology issues that affect productivity of Firm personnel
* This role is required to physically work in an EY office.

  


**Skills and attributes for success**


* Advanced analytical skills are required to address end\-user incidents escalated from the service desk or offered by end user on walk\-up issues.
* Decision making responsibilities can be made to address issues impacting large numbers of customers within the supported geography and communicate effectively to customers as necessary.
* Experience in leading projects and overseeing contribution and performance of project members
* A Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience is desirable.

  


**To qualify for the role you must have**


* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, organizational, project and time management skills.
* Excellent customer service attitude.
* Demonstrated multitasking abilities in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to liaise and work effectively with all levels of end users and IT personnel.
* Ability to communicate effectively with supervisor and peers.
* Approximately 4\-8 years of extensive experience in end user software and hardware and technology support

  


**What we offer**



As part of this role, you'll work in a highly integrated, globally diverse team with the opportunity and tools to grow, develop and drive your career forward. Here, you can combine global opportunity with flexible working. The EY benefits package goes above and beyond too, focusing on your physical, emotional, financial and social well\-being. Your recruiter can talk to you about the benefits available in your country. Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:


* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a significant impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be accepted for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  


**EY \| Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

  

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

  


Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
